public_rationale: This is an analytical claim about what the AI buildout 'needs', not a dated prediction or a reported fact. In the post, the $250 billion comes from his own setup: even if OpenAI and Anthropic spent $500 billion a year on compute, another $250 billion or more would be needed to justify the roughly 190GW he says is planned. Whether that is true depends on the buildout size, the cost per gigawatt, and what 'justify' means. He sets all of these with his own estimates, and no filing or official statistic settles them. No deadline is stated, so no later event could show the requirement was right or wrong. The 'two other companies' part is hedged with 'likely'. Anthropic's S-1 compute commitments show how large lab demand is, but they do not test the claim. I do not score it.
limitations: I did not build an independent model of the capex payback needed. Any such model would rest on assumptions I chose.
The speaker's buildout figures (190GW, $80–100 billion per GW) were not checked, because the claim cannot be scored either way.

from_speaker: "we need at least another $250 billion in annual AI compute demand"
"which likely means at least two other OpenAI or Anthropic-scale companies"
Context: "even if Anthropic and OpenAI spent $500 billion a year in annual compute ... we'd need at least another $250 billion or more in annual compute revenue to justify it"
our_interpretation: This is a statement about what is needed to justify the planned data-center buildout, based on the speaker's own estimates: about 190GW planned, costing $80–100 billion per GW, with OpenAI and Anthropic spending at most around $500 billion a year. It is not a prediction that something will or will not happen by a date.
'Another' is measured against OpenAI's and Anthropic's own compute spending. The baseline and the buildout size are his estimates, not reported figures.
The second part ('likely means at least two other ... companies') is hedged with 'likely' and is an inference from the dollar figure. It is not scored separately.
No deadline is stated in the sentence. The nearby text mentions 2030 and 'four years' as the time frame for the buildout.
criteria.support_condition: Would be supported if a reliable, independent analysis of the planned buildout cost and the needed return showed that justifying it requires at least $250 billion a year of AI compute demand beyond OpenAI and Anthropic.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Would be contradicted if such an analysis showed that the buildout could be justified with materially less than $250 billion a year of extra compute demand beyond OpenAI and Anthropic.
